integrity: The global lower bound uses symmetry averaging of arbitrary positive-definite quadratic forms followed by exact one-variable calculus. The bundled checker only replays algebraic identities and equality witnesses and is not treated as a proof of the global optimization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the real two-dimensional \(\ell_\infty-\ell_1\) Day–James norm. It does not classify neighboring parameters, complex scalars, or higher dimensions; an obscure older equivalent convex-geometric computation remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach–Mazur distance of the \(\ell_\infty-\ell_1\) Day–James plane
